questions.question_text: What negative impacts are associated with ash fall from a volcanic eruption?

marking_scheme.rubric: AO1 and AO2: Describe the negative impacts of volcanic ash.
keywords_required: Roofs can collapse under the heavy weight of the ash.
Respiratory problems and health issues for humans/animals.
Crops are smothered and killed, leading to food shortages.
Aviation disruption (planes cannot fly through ash clouds).

questions.question_text: What are some positive impacts of volcanic eruptions?

marking_scheme.rubric: AO1: Describe the benefits of living near volcanoes.
keywords_required: Volcanic ash and lava weather into highly fertile soils, excellent for farming.
Geothermal energy can be harnessed for electricity and heating.
Volcanoes attract tourists, providing income and jobs for locals.
Precious minerals can be mined.
A lahar is a violent type of mudflow or debris flow.
It is composed of a slurry of pyroclastic material, rocky debris, and water flowing down the slopes of a volcano.

questions.question_text: Identify one scale used to measure earthquakes. [1]

keywords_required: Richter scale OR Moment Magnitude scale OR Mercalli scale.

questions.question_text: Identify one scale used to measure volcanic eruptions. [1]

keywords_required: Volcanic Explosivity Index (VEI).

questions.question_text: Suggest two secondary impacts that could occur after an earthquake. [2]

marking_scheme.rubric: AO2: Differentiate secondary from primary impacts.
keywords_required: Tsunamis generated by underwater earthquakes.
Fires caused by ruptured gas pipes.
Disease outbreaks (e.g. cholera) from contaminated water supplies.
Landslides triggered by the shaking.

questions.question_text: Suggest two factors that can influence the severity of the impacts of earthquakes. [2]

keywords_required: Depth of the focus (shallower earthquakes usually cause more damage).
Magnitude of the earthquake.
Level of development (HICs have better infrastructure and building codes than LICs).
Population density of the affected area.
Time of day (people asleep in homes vs outdoors).
